Protagonist: an original adult male with East Asian features and short black hair; different lead and scene from the other variant. Scene must visibly combine: an unmistakably giant mechanical humanoid robot, articulated metal joints, pilot cockpit and machinery AND an enormous clearly living giant monster towering over buildings, colossal biological body and visible tiny city structures for scale. Integrate those into ONE coherent narrative scene, do not just place unrelated props together. Mood: quiet tension, difficult choices and atmospheric shadows. Composition: large expressive character portrait with atmospheric setting and story detail behind.

Mecha × Cosmic Horror, variant A. Style: sharp modern high-contrast anime, elegant black contours, graphic negative shapes, vivid limited colors. Protagonist: an original adult female with tan skin and silver hair; different lead and scene from the other variant. Scene must visibly combine: an unmistakably giant mechanical humanoid robot, articulated metal joints, pilot cockpit and machinery AND a vast incomprehensible cosmic entity, impossible geometry or many-eyed void dwarfing the protagonist; unsettling unknowable scale, no gore. Integrate those into ONE coherent narrative scene, do not just place unrelated props together. Mood: ominous dread and suspense. Composition: strong clear foreground character, active diagonal composition.

Mecha × Cosmic Horror, variant B. Style: bright rounded family-adventure anime, simple expressive shapes, smooth thick outlines, clean FLAT cel colors, very little texture. Protagonist: an original adult male with tan skin and silver hair; different lead and scene from the other variant. Scene must visibly combine: an unmistakably giant mechanical humanoid robot, articulated metal joints, pilot cockpit and machinery AND a vast incomprehensible cosmic entity, impossible geometry or many-eyed void dwarfing the protagonist; unsettling unknowable scale, no gore. Integrate those into ONE coherent narrative scene, do not just place unrelated props together. Mood: eerie stillness and overwhelming mystery. Composition: large expressive character portrait with atmospheric setting and story detail behind.

Mecha × Arabia, variant A. Style: delicate romantic anime illustration, elegant fine lines, airy watercolor, nuanced faces and soft light. Protagonist: an original adult female nonhuman with blue skin and pointed ears; different lead and scene from the other variant. Scene must visibly combine: an unmistakably giant mechanical humanoid robot, articulated metal joints, pilot cockpit and machinery AND a richly detailed Arabian-inspired desert city, domed architecture, lantern-filled souk, dunes and flowing embroidered clothing; culturally thoughtful adventure imagery. Integrate those into ONE coherent narrative scene, do not just place unrelated props together. Mood: hopeful energetic resolve. Composition: strong clear foreground character, active diagonal composition.
